title: Clean repo, ordinary session — no correlator should fire
description: Vanilla repo with a benign README, vanilla session running pytest. No structural tags fire on the inventory side; no concerning findings on the dynamic side. The expected correlator output is none — this is the FPR baseline case. (v0.18.1: README excluded from instruction-surface scanning, so the project produces no tags at all — clean baseline is now even cleaner.)

m2_expected.rationale: Clean repo with only a README. README is scanned by default (v0.18.2 reverted the v0.18.1 hardcoded skip), but the README content is benign — only `has_instruction_files` fires, no risk tags. Correlators find no static-side condition; correlator absent.
